text: Our Advantages 1.Advanced Education Principle CDIO learning by doing, employment oriented 2.High Teaching Quality The best in the best, high level teachers from software industry, projects from software industry 3.Highly recognized by Ministry of Education in China The office of national pilot software engineering schools locates in SSE at BJTU 4.Save Save a lot than study in western countries 5.English Program No HSK required, Chinese is benefit rather than barrier. 6.Learn Chinese Culture Chinese culture course + activities 7.Excellent Internship Chance Famous IT companies. Microsoft, SAP, Intel, IBM The goal of graduate program is to cultivate students master more sophisticated and systematic software engineering expertise, to cultivate internationalized and advanced software engineering talents with high-quality, practice ability and innovative spirits. Students will be qualified in R&D skills, project management, teaching ability, and many other related fields after graduation. The duration of full time graduate study is typically 2 years, maximum 3 years. Course work should be finished within 1 year and software engineering practice should not be less than 1 year. The courses explore the design, construction and management of large complex software systems, such as: • Requirements Analysis Engineering • Software Measurement • Software Process • Software Quality Assurance • Advanced Software Testing Technology • Business System Analysis • Information Security: Technology and Application • Data Warehouse and Data Mining • Service-Oriented Architecture and Application • Enterprise Application Platform • Multimedia Technology • Embedded System and Application • Digital Image Processing • Operating System and Computing Environment
